notes.title: Patch 1.1 is now live!
notes.notes:
Welcome back, Survivors.

Patch 1.1 for Arizona Sunshine® Remake is live, bringing fixes and quality of life updates to enhance your gameplay experience. If you encounter any issues or want to share your thoughts, join us on Discord.

Fixes

 Added ‘Reset to default settings’ option to reset all user settings back to original default settings
 Fixed a visual issue on items that sometimes duplicated when spawned in the world
 Fixed AA not working on foliage
 Fixed unable to join Damned or Deadman lobbies when trying to join them through the lobby list
 Fixed incorrect translation in the loading screen for Russian, Brazilian Portuguese, French, Italian and Polish
 Fixed faulty collision when throwing items when holding an AUG weapon
 Fixed headshot achievement not correctly tracking on Steam
 Fixed ‘Wearing Smell From Laboratories’ not triggering on Steam
 Fixed overlapping input mapping for ‘Crouch’ and ‘Rotate’ when using VIVE wand controllers
 Fixed numerous small system errors that could cause unexpected gameplay behavior
